## Checklist

- [ ] `make check` is green.
- [ ] New behavior has tests next to the code it lives in.
- [ ] User-facing behavior is documented in the README, and nowhere else.
- [ ] An option changed? It changed in `cli.Options`, and the generated option
      table was regenerated rather than edited.
- [ ] No build, test, lint or release command — and no version number — was
      written into a workflow under `.github/workflows/`.
- [ ] Anything worth a release note is in CHANGELOG.md, in its top section.
